title.en: Unit 8: Scholars, the Extra Ba, and Stories
title.ur: Ikayi 8: Ulama, Ziyada Ba aur Qissay

title.en: Scholars who won the King Faisal Prize
title.ur: King Faisal Award jeetne wale ulama

intro.en: In this lesson you read short biographies of three well-known scholars who served Islam: Ibn Baz, al-Tantawi and Ahmad Deedat. Read slowly, sentence by sentence, and notice the words for study, teaching and da'wah.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum teen mashhoor ulama ki mukhtasar seerat parhenge jinhon ne Islam ki khidmat ki: Ibn Baz, Tantawi aur Ahmad Deedat. Aahista aahista, jumla ba jumla parhein aur parhai, tadrees aur dawat ke alfaz par dhyan dein.
intro.ar: في هَذا الدَّرْسِ تَقْرَأُ سِيَرًا قَصيرَةً لِثَلاثَةِ عُلَماءَ خَدَموا الإِسْلامَ: ابْنِ بازٍ وَالطَّنْطاوِيِّ وَأَحْمَدَ ديدات. اِقْرَأْ بِبُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً، وَانْتَبِهْ لِكَلِماتِ الدِّراسَةِ وَالتَّعْليمِ وَالدَّعْوَةِ.

dialogue.ar: تُمْنَحُ جائِزَةُ المَلِكِ فَيْصَلٍ كُلَّ عامٍ لِعُلَماءَ قَدَّموا خِدْمَةً كَبيرَةً لِلإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: tumnaḥu jāʾizatul-maliki faysalin kulla ʿāmin li-ʿulamāʾa qaddamū khidmatan kabīratan lil-islām
dialogue.en: The King Faisal Prize is given every year to scholars who rendered great service to Islam.
dialogue.ur: King Faisal Award har saal un ulama ko diya jata hai jinhon ne Islam ki bari khidmat ki.

dialogue.ar: مِنْهُمُ الشَّيْخُ عَبْدُ العَزيزِ بْنُ بازٍ، الَّذي وُلِدَ في الرِّياضِ وَحَفِظَ القُرْآنَ وَهُوَ صَغيرٌ.
dialogue.tr: minhumush-shaykhu ʿabdul-ʿazīzi bnu bāz, alladhī wulida fir-riyāḍi wa ḥafiẓal-qurʾāna wa huwa ṣaghīr
dialogue.en: Among them is Sheikh Abdul Aziz ibn Baz, who was born in Riyadh and memorised the Quran while still young.
dialogue.ur: Un mein Shaykh Abdul Aziz bin Baz hain, jo Riyadh mein paida hue aur bachpan hi mein Quran hifz kiya.

dialogue.ar: دَرَّسَ العُلومَ الشَّرْعِيَّةَ في الجامِعَةِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ، وَاشْتُهِرَ بِالفِقْهِ وَالفَتْوى.
dialogue.tr: darrasal-ʿulūmash-sharʿiyyata fil-jāmiʿatil-islāmiyyah, wa shtuhira bil-fiqhi wal-fatwā
dialogue.en: He taught the religious sciences at the Islamic University and became famous for fiqh and fatwa.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne Islami university mein deeni uloom padhaye aur fiqh aur fatwa mein mashhoor hue.

dialogue.ar: وَعَمِلَ في القَضاءِ سَنَواتٍ، ثُمَّ تَفَرَّغَ لِلتَّدْريسِ وَالدَّعْوَةِ.
dialogue.tr: wa ʿamila fil-qaḍāʾi sanawāt, thumma tafarragha lit-tadrīsi wad-daʿwah
dialogue.en: He worked in the judiciary for some years, then devoted himself to teaching and da’wah.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne kuch saal qaza mein kaam kiya, phir tadrees aur dawat ke liye apne ko faarigh kar liya.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمُ الشَّيْخُ عَلِيٌّ الطَّنْطاوِيُّ، الكاتِبُ الَّذي وُلِدَ في دِمَشْقَ وَأَلَّفَ كُتُباً كَثيرَةً.
dialogue.tr: wa minhumush-shaykhu ʿaliyyun aṭ-ṭanṭāwiyy, al-kātibul-ladhī wulida fī dimashqa wa allafa kutuban kathīrah
dialogue.en: And among them is Sheikh Ali al-Tantawi, the writer who was born in Damascus and wrote many books.
dialogue.ur: Aur un mein Shaykh Ali Tantawi hain, adeeb jo Damishq mein paida hue aur bahut si kitabein likhin.

dialogue.ar: أَحَبَّ النّاسُ حَديثَهُ الجَميلَ في الإِذاعَةِ وَالتِّلْفازِ وَمُحاضَراتِهِ.
dialogue.tr: aḥabban-nāsu ḥadīthahul-jamīla fil-idhāʿati wat-tilfāzi wa muḥāḍarātih
dialogue.en: People loved his beautiful speech on the radio and television and in his lectures.
dialogue.ur: Logon ne radio aur television aur unke lectures mein unki pyari guftagu ko pasand kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَمِنْهُمُ الدّاعِيَةُ أَحْمَدُ دِيدات، الَّذي عاشَ في جَنوبِ إِفْريقِيا.
dialogue.tr: wa minhumud-dāʿiyatu aḥmadu dīdāt, alladhī ʿāsha fī janūbi ifrīqiyā
dialogue.en: And among them is the preacher Ahmad Deedat, who lived in South Africa.
dialogue.ur: Aur un mein daai Ahmad Deedat hain, jo Janubi Afreeqa mein rahe.

dialogue.ar: اشْتُهِرَ بِمُناظَراتِهِ وَمُحاضَراتِهِ أَمامَ خُصومٍ كَثيرينَ دَفاعاً عَنِ الإِسْلامِ.
dialogue.tr: ushtuhira bi-munāẓarātihi wa muḥāḍarātihi amāma khuṣūmin kathīrīna difāʿan ʿanil-islām
dialogue.en: He became famous for his debates and lectures before many opponents in defence of Islam.
dialogue.ur: Woh apne munazron aur lectures se mashhoor hue jo unhon ne bahut se mukhalifeen ke saamne Islam ke difa mein kiye.

q.ur: «جائِزَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: ما يُعْطى لِمَنْ يَتَفَوَّقُ تَكْريمًا لَهُ

q.en: Where was Sheikh Ibn Baz born, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Shaikh Ibn Baz kahan paida hue?
q.ar: أَيْنَ وُلِدَ الشَّيْخُ ابْنُ بازٍ بِحَسَبِ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Which scholar was from South Africa?
q.ur: Kaun sa aalim Junubi Afreeqa se tha?
q.ar: أَيُّ العُلَماءِ كانَ مِنْ جَنوبِ أَفْريقِيا؟

q.ur: «مُناظَرَةٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: حِوارٌ بَيْنَ شَخْصَيْنِ يُدافِعُ كُلٌّ عَنْ رَأْيِهِ

q.ur: "University" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى مَكانِ الدِّراسَةِ العالِيَةِ؟

title.ar: قَواعِدُ اللُّغَةِ: زِيادَةُ «الباءِ» في خَبَرِ «لَيْسَ» وَ«ما»
title.en: Grammar: the extra «ba» in the predicate of «laysa» and «ma»
title.ur: Qawaid: «laysa» aur «ma» ki khabar mein ziyada «ba»

intro.en: After «لَيْسَ» or «ما» (meaning 'is not'), the predicate (khabar) can take an extra letter «بِ» in front of it. It adds emphasis, and the word after it ends with a kasra. Example: «لَسْتُ مُخْلِفاً» or «لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ» – both mean 'I do not break my promise'.
intro.ur: «لَيْسَ» ya «ما» (yaani 'nahin') ke baad khabar se pehle ek ziyada harf «بِ» aa sakta hai. Isse baat mein zor aa jata hai aur khabar ke aakhir mein kasra aata hai. Misal: «لَسْتُ مُخْلِفاً» ya «لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ» – dono ka matlab hai 'main wada khilafi nahin karta'.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ «لَيْسَ» أَوْ «ما» النّافِيَةِ يَجوزُ أَنْ يَدْخُلَ حَرْفُ «بِ» الزّائِدُ عَلى الخَبَرِ لِلتَّوْكيدِ، وَيَكونُ الخَبَرُ بَعْدَهُ مَجْرورًا بِالكَسْرَةِ. مِثالٌ: «لَسْتُ مُخْلِفاً» أَوْ «لَسْتُ بِمُخْلِفٍ»، وَالمَعْنى واحِدٌ.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ خالِدٌ بِمُخْلِفٍ لِمَوْعِدِهِ.
dialogue.tr: laysa khālidun bi-mukhlifin li-mawʿidih
dialogue.en: Khalid is not one who breaks his appointment.
dialogue.ur: Khalid apna waada khilaf karne wala nahi hai.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ المُؤْمِنُ بِالطَّعّانِ وَلا اللَّعّانِ.
dialogue.tr: laysal-muʾminu biṭ-ṭaʿʿāni wa lal-laʿʿān
dialogue.en: The believer is not one who slanders or curses.
dialogue.ur: Momin tana dene wala aur lanat karne wala nahi hota.

dialogue.ar: ما أَنْتَ بِمُغَفَّلٍ يا صَديقي.
dialogue.tr: mā anta bi-mughaffalin yā ṣadīqī
dialogue.en: You are no fool, my friend.
dialogue.ur: Aap bewaqoof nahi hain, mere dost.

dialogue.ar: ما المُجْتَهِدُ بِخاسِرٍ في الامْتِحانِ.
dialogue.tr: mal-mujtahidu bi-khāsirin fil-imtiḥān
dialogue.en: The hard-working student is not a loser in the exam.
dialogue.ur: Mehnati talib-e-ilm imtihan mein nakaam nahi hota.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ المُهْمِلُ بِمَحْمودٍ بَيْنَ زُمَلائِهِ.
dialogue.tr: laysal-muhmilu bi-maḥmūdin bayna zumalāʾih
dialogue.en: The careless person is not praised among his classmates.
dialogue.ur: Laaparwah shakhs apne saathiyon mein qabil-e-tareef nahi hota.

dialogue.ar: ما الكَذِبُ بِمَقْبولٍ وَلا بِمَحْمودٍ.
dialogue.tr: mal-kadhibu bi-maqbūlin wa lā bi-maḥmūd
dialogue.en: Lying is neither accepted nor praised.
dialogue.ur: Jhoot na qabool hai na qabil-e-tareef.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَ الفَقيرُ بِمَذْمومٍ لِفَقْرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: laysal-faqīru bi-madhmūmin li-faqrih
dialogue.en: The poor man is not blameworthy for his poverty.
dialogue.ur: Gareeb apni gareebi ki wajah se qabil-e-muzammat nahi.

dialogue.ar: ما الحاضِرونَ في الصَّفِّ بِقَليلينَ.
dialogue.tr: mal-ḥāḍirūna fiṣ-ṣaffi bi-qalīlīn
dialogue.en: Those present in the class are not few.
dialogue.ur: Class mein hazir hone wale kam nahi hain.

q.en: Which sentence has the extra «بِ» in the predicate?
q.ur: Kis jumle ki khabar mein ziyada «بِ» hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ فيها «بِ» الزّائِدَةُ في الخَبَرِ؟

q.en: What is the ending of the word after the extra «بِ»?
q.ur: Ziyada «بِ» ke baad wale lafz ka aakhri harkat kya hoti hai?
q.ar: ما حَرَكَةُ الكَلِمَةِ الَّتي بَعْدَ «بِ» الزّائِدَةِ؟

q.en: What does «لَيْسَ الفَقيرُ بِمَذْمومٍ لِفَقْرِهِ» mean?
q.ur: «لَيْسَ الفَقيرُ بِمَذْمومٍ لِفَقْرِهِ» ka kya matlab hai?

options: The poor man is not blameworthy for his poverty

q.ur: "Kamzor" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
Ziyada «بِ» kis ke baad aata hai?

title.ur: Sunna aur samajhna: Zehnon ki hijrat

intro.en: This lesson is about listening to a text on «هِجْرَةُ العُقولِ» (the migration of educated minds from poorer countries to the West). Listen to the audio, then decide which statements are true or false, and finish with a short speaking task.
intro.ur: Yeh sabaq «هِجْرَةُ العُقولِ» yaani parhe likhe logon aur ulama ke ghareeb mulkon se Maghrib ki taraf hijrat ke baare mein sun kar samajhne ka hai. Audio sunein, phir sahih ya ghalat batayein, aur aakhir mein chhota sa guftagu ka kaam karein.
intro.ar: يَدورُ هَذا الدَّرْسُ حَوْلَ نَصٍّ مَسْموعٍ عَنْ «هِجْرَةِ العُقولِ»، أَيِ انْتِقالِ المُتَعَلِّمينَ مِنَ البُلْدانِ الفَقيرَةِ إِلى الغَرْبِ. اِسْتَمِعْ ثُمَّ حَدِّدِ الصَّوابَ وَالخَطَأَ، وَاخْتِمْ بِتَدْريبٍ قَصيرٍ عَلى الكَلامِ.

dialogue.ar: تَنْهَضُ الأُمَمُ بِعُقولِ أَبْنائِها المُتَعَلِّمينَ.
dialogue.tr: tanhaḍul-umamu bi-ʿuqūli abnāʾihal-mutaʿallimīn
dialogue.en: Nations rise through the minds of their educated sons.
dialogue.ur: Qaumein apne parhe likhe beton ki aqal se taraqqi karti hain.

dialogue.ar: يَهْجُرُ بَعْضُ الأَطِبّاءِ وَالباحِثينَ أَوْطانَهُمْ وَيُهاجِرونَ إِلى دُوَلٍ غَرْبِيَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: yahjuru baʿḍul-aṭibbāʾi wal-bāḥithīna awṭānahum wa yuhājirūna ilā duwalin gharbiyyah
dialogue.en: Some doctors and researchers leave their homelands and migrate to Western countries.
dialogue.ur: Kuch doctor aur muhaqqiq apne watan chhor kar maghribi mulkon ko hijrat kar jate hain.

dialogue.ar: مِنْ أَسْبابِ هذِهِ الهِجْرَةِ قِلَّةُ مَجالاتِ البَحْثِ وَالمُضايَقاتُ وَضَعْفُ الرّاتِبِ.
dialogue.tr: min asbābi hādhihil-hijrati qillatu majālātil-baḥthi wal-muḍāyaqātu wa ḍaʿfur-rātib
dialogue.en: Among the reasons for this migration are few research fields, harassment and low pay.
dialogue.ur: Is hijrat ki wajoohat mein tehqeeq ke mauqon ki kami, tang kiya jana aur kam tankhwah hain.

dialogue.ar: تَمْنَعُ الدُّوَلُ هِجْرَةَ العُقولِ إِذا احْتَرَمَتِ العُلَماءَ وَوَفَّرَتْ لَهُمُ العَمَلَ.
dialogue.tr: tamnaʿud-duwalu hijratal-ʿuqūli idhā ḥtaramatil-ʿulamāʾa wa waffarat lahumul-ʿamal
dialogue.en: Countries stop the brain drain when they respect scholars and provide them with work.
dialogue.ur: Mulk zehnon ki hijrat ko tab rokte hain jab ulama ki izzat karein aur unhein kaam muhayya karein.

dialogue.ar: ناقِشْ زَميلَكَ: دِراسَةُ الطِّبِّ في الوَطَنِ أَمْ في بَلَدٍ آخَرَ.
dialogue.tr: nāqish zamīlak: dirāsatuṭ-ṭibbi fil-waṭani am fī baladin ākhar
dialogue.en: Discuss with your classmate: studying medicine at home or in another country.
dialogue.ur: Apne saathi se behes karein: tib ki parhai watan mein ya kisi aur mulk mein.

q.ur: «هِجْرَةُ العُقولِ» ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: انْتِقالُ العُلَماءِ وَالمُتَعَلِّمينَ مِنْ بُلْدانِهِمْ إِلى بُلْدانٍ أُخْرى

q.ur: "Tehqeeq" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى دِراسَةٍ عِلْمِيَّةٍ لِمَعْرِفَةِ شَيْءٍ؟

q.ur: «الدُّوَلُ النّامِيَةُ» ka matlab:
«الوَطَنُ» ka matlab kya hai?

title.ar: قَواعِدُ اللُّغَةِ: كَفُّ «إِنَّ» وَأَخَواتِها عَنِ العَمَلِ
title.en: Grammar: «ma» stops «inna» and her sisters from working
title.ur: Qawaid: «ma» se «inna» aur uski behnon ka amal ruk jana

intro.en: Normally «إِنَّ» puts the subject in the accusative: «إِنَّ العِلْمَ نورٌ». When «ما» is added after it («إِنَّما»), it stops working, and the noun after it stays in the nominative: «إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ». The same happens with «لَكِنَّما», «لَيْتَما» and «كَأَنَّما». «إِنَّما» often means ‘only’ or ‘indeed’.
intro.ur: Aam tor par «إِنَّ» ism ko mansoob karti hai: «إِنَّ العِلْمَ نورٌ». Jab uske baad «ما» lag jaye («إِنَّما») to woh amal nahi karti aur ism marfoo rehta hai: «إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ». «لَكِنَّما»، «لَيْتَما» aur «كَأَنَّما» ka bhi yahi hukm hai. «إِنَّما» aksar ‘sirf’ ya ‘bila shuba’ ke maani deti hai.
intro.ar: الأَصْلُ أَنْ تَنْصِبَ «إِنَّ» الاسْمَ: «إِنَّ العِلْمَ نورٌ». فَإِذا زيدَتْ «ما» بَعْدَها («إِنَّما») كُفَّتْ عَنِ العَمَلِ وَبَقِيَ الاسْمُ مَرْفوعًا: «إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ». وَكَذَلِكَ «لَكِنَّما» وَ«لَيْتَما» وَ«كَأَنَّما». وَ«إِنَّما» تُفيدُ الحَصْرَ وَالتَّوْكيدَ.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ العِلْمَ نورٌ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-ʿilma nūr
dialogue.en: Knowledge is light.
dialogue.ur: Ilm roshni hai.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ.
dialogue.tr: innamal-ʿilmu nūr
dialogue.en: Knowledge is only light. (with «ma»: no change to the noun)
dialogue.ur: Ilm to bas roshni hai. («ma» ke baad ism nahi badalta)

dialogue.ar: إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ
dialogue.tr: innamal-aʿmālu bin-niyyāt
dialogue.en: Actions are only by intentions.
dialogue.ur: Amal ka daromadar niyyaton par hai.

dialogue.ar: لَيْلى مُجْتَهِدَةٌ لَكِنَّما أُخْتُها كَسولَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: laylā mujtahidatun lākinnamā ukhtuhā kasūlah
dialogue.en: Layla is hard-working, but her sister is lazy.
dialogue.ur: Layla mehnati hai lekin uski behen susta hai.

dialogue.ar: أَلا لَيْتَما العُطْلَةُ طَويلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: alā laytamal-ʿuṭlatu ṭawīlah
dialogue.en: If only the holiday were long.
dialogue.ur: Kaash chhutti lambi hoti.

dialogue.ar: كَأَنَّما الشّاطِئُ لَوْحَةٌ جَميلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ka-annamash-shāṭiʾu lawḥatun jamīlah
dialogue.en: It is as if the beach were a beautiful painting.
dialogue.ur: Goya sahil ek khoobsurat tasveer hai.

dialogue.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا يُوحَىٰ إِلَيَّ أَنَّمَا إِلَٰهُكُمْ إِلَٰهٌ وَاحِدٌ
dialogue.tr: qul innamā yūḥā ilayya annamā ilāhukum ilāhun wāḥid
dialogue.en: Say: It is only revealed to me that your God is One God.
dialogue.ur: Keh do: Mujh par to bas yahi wahi aati hai ke tumhara mabood ek hi mabood hai.

vocab.en: a particle that changes the sentence (like inna)

q.ur: «إِنَّما» ka aam matlab kya hota hai?

q.ur: «إِنَّ» ke saath «ما» lagane se kya hota hai?

options: It stops working on the noun

«إِنَّما العِلْمُ نورٌ» ka kya matlab hai?

intro.en: Three stories with lessons: a content man on a bus despite his poverty, a young man who asks a wise sheikh about repentance, and a night guest in Madinah (a story of the Ansar). Read them slowly and think about the lesson in each.
intro.ur: Teen sabaq-amoz kahaniyan: bus mein ek qanaat-pasand aadmi jo gareebi ke bawajood mutmain hai, ek naujawan jo hakeem shaykh se tauba ke bare mein poochta hai, aur Madinah mein raat ka mehmaan (Ansar ka qissa). Unhein aahista padhein aur har mein sabaq par ghaur karein.
intro.ar: ثَلاثُ قِصَصٍ فيها عِبَرٌ: رَجُلٌ قَنوعٌ في حافِلَةٍ مَعَ فَقْرِهِ، وَشابٌّ يَسْأَلُ شَيْخاً حَكيماً عَنِ التَّوْبَةِ، وَضَيْفُ اللَّيْلِ في المَدينَةِ (قِصَّةٌ مِنَ الأَنْصارِ). اِقْرَأْها بِبُطْءٍ وَتَأَمَّلِ العِبْرَةَ في كُلٍّ مِنْها.

dialogue.ar: القِصَّةُ الأُولى: جَلَسْتُ في الحافِلَةِ إِلى جانِبِ رَجُلٍ بَسيطِ الثِّيابِ يَدْفَعُ الأُجْرَةَ بِقِطَعٍ صَغيرَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: al-qiṣṣatul-ūlā: jalastu fil-ḥāfilati ilā jānibi rajulin basīṭith-thiyābi yadfaʿul-ujrata bi-qiṭaʿin ṣaghīrah
dialogue.en: Story one: I sat on the bus beside a man in simple clothes who paid the fare in small coins.
dialogue.ur: Pehli kahani: main bus mein ek saade kapdon wale aadmi ke paas baitha jo chhote sikkon se kiraya de raha tha.

dialogue.ar: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ عَمَلِهِ فَقالَ: أَنَا مُوَظَّفٌ في مَدْرَسَةٍ، وَلي خَمْسَةُ أَطْفالٍ.
dialogue.tr: saʾaltuhu ʿan ʿamalihi fa-qāl: ana muwaẓẓafun fī madrasah, wa lī khamsatu aṭfāl
dialogue.en: I asked him about his work and he said: I am an employee in a school, and I have five children.
dialogue.ur: Main ne uske kaam ke bare mein poocha to bola: Main ek school mein mulazim hoon aur mere paanch bachche hain.

dialogue.ar: راتِبي قَليلٌ، لكِنَّ اللهَ رَزَقَني الصِّحَّةَ وَالإيمانَ، وَهذِهِ أَكْبَرُ نِعْمَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: rātibī qalīl, lākinna llāha razaqaniṣ-ṣiḥḥata wal-īmān, wa hādhihi akbaru niʿmah
dialogue.en: My salary is small, but Allah has provided me with health and faith, and this is the greatest blessing.
dialogue.ur: Meri tankhwah kam hai, magar Allah ne mujhe sehat aur iman diya, aur yeh sab se bari naimat hai.

dialogue.ar: فَاسْتَغْرَبْتُ رِضاهُ، وَقُلْتُ في نَفْسي: ما أَحْلى القَناعَةَ وَالتَّوَكُّلَ عَلى اللهِ!
dialogue.tr: fa-staghrabtu riḍāhu, wa qultu fī nafsī: mā aḥlal-qanāʿata wat-tawakkula ʿalā llāh
dialogue.en: I was amazed at his contentment and said to myself: how sweet are contentment and trust in Allah!
dialogue.ur: Mujhe uski razamandi par hairat hui aur dil mein kaha: qanaat aur Allah par bharosa kitna meetha hai!

dialogue.ar: القِصَّةُ الثّانِيَةُ: جاءَ شابٌّ إِلى شَيْخٍ حَكيمٍ وَقالَ: أَقَعُ في المَعاصي ثُمَّ أَنْدَمُ، فَماذا أَفْعَلُ؟
dialogue.tr: al-qiṣṣatuth-thāniyah: jāʾa shābbun ilā shaykhin ḥakīm wa qāl: aqaʿu fil-maʿāṣī thumma andam, fa-mādhā afʿal
dialogue.en: Story two: A young man came to a wise sheikh and said: I fall into sins and then regret, so what should I do?
dialogue.ur: Doosri kahani: ek naujawan ek hakeem shaykh ke paas aaya aur bola: Main gunahon mein par jata hoon phir pachhtata hoon, main kya karoon?

dialogue.ar: قالَ الشَّيْخُ: تَذَكَّرْ أَنَّ مَلَكَ المَوْتِ يَقْبِضُ الأَرْواحَ في أَيِّ لَحْظَةٍ، فَلا تُؤَخِّرِ التَّوْبَةَ.
dialogue.tr: qālash-shaykh: tadhakkar anna malakal-mawti yaqbiḍul-arwāḥa fī ayyi laḥẓah, fa-lā tuʾakhkhiri t-tawbah
dialogue.en: The sheikh said: Remember that the Angel of Death takes souls at any moment, so do not delay repentance.
dialogue.ur: Shaykh ne kaha: Yaad rakh ke malak-ul-maut kisi bhi lamhe rooh qabz karta hai, isliye tauba mein der na kar.

dialogue.ar: وَتُبْ إِلى اللهِ تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً، وَاعْزِمْ أَلّا تَعودَ إِلى الذَّنْبِ.
dialogue.tr: wa tub ilā llāhi tawbatan naṣūḥan, waʿzim allā taʿūda ilādh-dhanb
dialogue.en: And repent to Allah with a sincere repentance, and resolve not to return to the sin.
dialogue.ur: Allah ke saamne saccha tauba kar aur pakka irada kar ke gunah ki taraf na lautega.

dialogue.ar: فَبَكى الشّابُّ وَلَزِمَ العِبادَةَ وَابْتَعَدَ عَنِ المَعاصي، وَلَمْ تَعُدِ الدُّنْيا أَكْبَرَ هَمِّهِ.
dialogue.tr: fa-bakash-shābbu wa lazimal-ʿibādata wa btaʿada ʿanil-maʿāṣī, wa lam taʿudid-dunyā akbara hammih
dialogue.en: The young man wept, stayed devoted to worship and kept away from sins, and the world was no longer his greatest concern.
dialogue.ur: Naujawan roya, ibadat ko lazim pakda aur gunahon se door ho gaya, aur duniya uski sab se bari fikr na rahi.

dialogue.ar: القِصَّةُ الثّالِثَةُ: جاءَ إِلى المَدينَةِ ضَيْفٌ غَريبٌ في آخِرِ اللَّيْلِ، وَقَدْ أَتْعَبَهُ السَّفَرُ وَالجوعُ.
dialogue.tr: al-qiṣṣatuth-thālithah: jāʾa ilal-madīnati ḍayfun gharībun fī ākhiril-layl, wa qad atʿabahus-safaru wal-jūʿ
dialogue.en: Story three: A stranger arrived as a guest in Madinah at the end of the night, worn out by travel and hunger.
dialogue.ur: Teesri kahani: raat ke aakhir mein ek ajnabi mehmaan Madinah aaya, safar aur bhook se thaka hua.

dialogue.ar: فَاصْطَحَبَهُ رَجُلٌ كَريمٌ مِنَ الأَنْصارِ إِلى بَيْتِهِ، وَأَشْعَلَتْ زَوْجَتُهُ السِّراجَ وَجَهَّزَتِ الطَّعامَ.
dialogue.tr: fa-aṣṭaḥabahu rajulun karīmun minal-anṣāri ilā baytih, wa ashʿalat zawjatuhus-sirāja wa jahhazatiṭ-ṭaʿām
dialogue.en: A generous man of the Ansar took him to his house, and his wife lit the lamp and prepared the food.
dialogue.ur: Ansar ka ek sakhi aadmi use apne ghar le gaya, aur uski biwi ne chiragh jalaya aur khana tayyar kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ الرَّجُلُ: بَيْتُنا بَيْتُكَ، وَما عِنْدَنا نَقْتَسِمُهُ مَعَكَ. فَتَعَلَّمَ الضَّيْفُ أَنَّ الكَرَمَ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى غِنًى.
dialogue.tr: wa qālar-rajulu: baytunā baytuk, wa mā ʿindanā naqtasimuhu maʿak. fa-taʿallamaḍ-ḍayfu anna l-karama lā yaḥtāju ilā ghinā
dialogue.en: The man said: Our house is your house, and what we have we share with you. The guest learned that generosity needs no wealth.
dialogue.ur: Mezbaan ne kaha: Hamara ghar aap ka ghar hai aur jo kuch hamare paas hai aap ke saath baant lenge. Mehmaan ne seekha ke sakhawat ke liye ameeri zaroori nahi.

q.ur: «ضَيْفٌ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: In the first story, how many children did the man have?
q.ur: Pehli kahani mein aadmi ke kitne bachche the?
q.ar: في القِصَّةِ الأُولى، كَمْ طِفْلاً كانَ لِلرَّجُلِ؟

q.ur: «التَّوْبَةُ» ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: In the second story, what did the sheikh advise the young man to do?
q.ur: Doosri kahani mein shaykh ne naujawan ko kya karne ki nasihat ki?
q.ar: في القِصَّةِ الثّانِيَةِ، بِماذا نَصَحَ الشَّيْخُ الشّابَّ؟

options: To go on a long journey
options_ar: أَنْ يَتوبَ تَوْبَةً نَصوحاً دونَ تَأْخيرٍ

q.en: In the third story, what did the Ansari and his wife do for their guest?
q.ur: Teesri kahani mein Ansari aur uski biwi ne mehmaan ke liye kya kiya?
q.ar: في القِصَّةِ الثّالِثَةِ، ماذا فَعَلَ الأَنْصارِيُّ وَزَوْجَتُهُ لِضَيْفِهِما؟

options: Took him home and shared their food
options_ar: أَخَذاهُ إِلى بَيْتِهِما وَاقْتَسَما الطَّعامَ مَعَهُ

intro.en: A review test on earlier units. It brings together reading questions on the King Faisal Prize, the history of teaching in the Muslim world (kuttab schools, teachers and the muhtasib), grammar (extra «بِ», «إِنَّما») and word sorting. Use the answers slides to check yourself.
intro.ur: Pichhli ikaiyon ki dohrai ka imtihan. Is mein King Faisal Prize par parhne ke sawal, Islami dunya mein taleem ki tareekh (kuttab, muallim aur muhtasib), qawaid (ziyada «بِ»، «إِنَّما») aur alfaz ki tarteeb shamil hain. Jawab wali slides se apna jawab check karein.
intro.ar: اِخْتِبارٌ لِمُراجَعَةِ الوَحَداتِ السّابِقَةِ: أَسْئِلَةُ قِراءَةٍ عَنْ جائِزَةِ المَلِكِ فَيْصَلٍ وَتاريخِ التَّعْليمِ في العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ (الكَتاتيبُ وَالمُعَلِّمونَ وَالمُحْتَسِبُ) وَقَواعِدُ («بِ» الزّائِدَةُ وَ«إِنَّما») وَتَصْنيفُ الكَلِماتِ. اِسْتَعِنْ بِشَرائِحِ الإِجاباتِ لِتَتَحَقَّقَ بِنَفْسِكَ.

q.ur: «الاِخْتِبارُ» ka matlab kya hai?
"Ustaad" ke liye kaun sa lafz hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى مَنْ يُعَلِّمُ الطُّلّابَ؟

q.en: Which sentence is correct with the extra «بِ»?
q.ur: Ziyada «بِ» ke saath kaun sa jumla durust hai?
«الحِسابُ» ka matlab kya hai?
